title: fix: a checkbox roadmap imports into a list that already has rows
headline: A project whose improvement list is already data can now move its checkbox roadmap in, so the 1.36.0 use check has a way out. The template state no longer ships view hashes that clashed in every project, and a roadmap step can be placed by command.
alignment: v1.36.1 fixes what verifying 1.36.0 in the workbench found, so every kit project can finish the move to a roadmap kept as data.

items.text: `list import` of a checkbox roadmap adds its rows to a list that already holds rows, with new ids, and keeps any roadmap step the state already holds; a file of tables still needs an empty list.
items.where: A roadmap beside a list kept as data

items.text: The template state holds no view hash, so install no longer clashes on a project's own state; a view block still showing the template's empty view is filled at the first change.
items.before: A clash to merge by hand

items.text: A folder change back after a kit script (Pop-Location, popd) no longer makes the guards hold the script as a write to a protected file.
step move places a roadmap step before or after another, by its name or release.

verification: Each fix has a test that fails on 1.36.0 and passes here.
In a throwaway project on 1.35.0 data with 4 rows, a checkbox roadmap moves in with new ids and the rows it held are untouched.

decisions.decision: A fix release, in the same thread
decisions.why: The owner picked a 1.36.1 fix build by pop-up after the workbench verify found the dead end; 1.36.0 stays unshipped until this verifies.

dimensions.name: Code security
dimensions.result: The guard's folder change back; see the review

upgrading: Run `install user` first, then `install project` in each project. A project the 1.36.0 use check stopped moves its checkbox roadmap with `list import` now.
limits: Boxes under a heading the state already holds as a step keep that step as it is; its carries and state are not read again.

tests.flips: declared tests on v1.36.0 and on this branch; the PR run gives the final count
